completion_promises.criterion_text: GraphitiWriteHelper constructable with client=None; schedule_write returns None and logs no error when client is None
completion_promises.evidence: GraphitiWriteHelper.__init__ accepts client: GraphitiClientLike | None and short-circuits at the top of schedule_write. TestNoneClient::test_returns_none_and_logs_no_error asserts both no return value and zero WARNING/ERROR log records.

completion_promises.criterion_text: schedule_write returns an asyncio.Task for valid input + non-None client
completion_promises.evidence: schedule_write builds an asyncio.create_task wrapping _perform_write and returns it. TestScheduleWriteValid::test_returns_asyncio_task asserts isinstance(task, asyncio.Task) and that exactly one add_episode call is made on the fake client.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Caller-facing schedule_write returns in < 50ms even when the eventual add_episode would take 80s+ (no await in the dispatcher path)
completion_promises.evidence: schedule_write is synchronous and only calls asyncio.create_task; no await in its body. TestFireAndForget::test_dispatcher_returns_under_50ms_with_hanging_mock measures elapsed wall-clock time with a mock that sleeps 80s and asserts < 0.05s.

completion_promises.criterion_text: _perform_write catches BaseException, emits graphiti_write_failed log line with error_class, and returns None — never raises
completion_promises.evidence: _perform_write wraps the underlying call in try/except BaseException and emits a structured log line containing event=graphiti_write_failed and error_class. TestPerformWriteFailure::test_failure_is_logged_and_swallowed mocks add_episode to raise RuntimeError, awaits the task without raising, and asserts the failed log + correct error_class.

sanitise_misconception_text appends TRUNCATION_SUFFIX once length exceeds MAX_MISCONCEPTION_TEXT_LENGTH. TestSanitiseMisconceptionText::test_truncates_oversized_input_within_cap exercises the 1000-char input path and asserts len(result) <= 500 and the truncation suffix.

completion_promises.criterion_text: sanitise_misconception_text strips ASCII control chars except \n, \t
completion_promises.evidence: _CONTROL_CHARS_PATTERN matches \x00-\x08, \x0B-\x0C, \x0E-\x1F (excluding \t=0x09 and \n=0x0A). TestSanitiseMisconceptionText::test_strips_ascii_control_chars_except_tab_and_newline asserts \x00, \x01, \x1F are stripped while \n and \t are preserved.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Texts matching (?i)(ignore previous|system:|<\|.*\|>|\[INST\]) are dropped (log line graphiti_write_dropped_injection); no add_episode call is made
completion_promises.evidence: schedule_write catches the ValueError raised by sanitise_misconception_text on injection match and emits event=graphiti_write_dropped_injection without scheduling a task. TestMisconceptionPath::test_injection_payload_is_dropped_with_log asserts task is None, the log line is present, and FakeClient.calls is empty. Parameterised TestSanitiseMisconceptionText::test_rejects_coarse_injection_patterns covers all four pattern families.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Empty group_ids is rejected (log line graphiti_write_dropped_invalid)
completion_promises.evidence: _validate_group_ids raises ValueError when the list is empty; schedule_write catches it and logs graphiti_write_dropped_invalid. TestValidation::test_empty_group_ids_rejected asserts the rejection + log + no add_episode call.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Group-ids not matching the three prefix patterns are rejected
completion_promises.evidence: _validate_group_ids requires each id to start with STUDENT_GROUP_PREFIX, SUBJECT_GROUP_PREFIX, or equal FLEET_GROUP_ID. Parameterised TestValidation::test_malformed_group_id_rejected covers wrong-prefix, no-prefix, wrong-fleet-constant, and empty-string cases.

completion_promises.criterion_text: drain() awaits all in-flight tasks up to shutdown_grace_sec; returns (succeeded, abandoned) counts; emits graphiti_write_abandoned_at_shutdown for each unfinished task
completion_promises.evidence: drain() takes a snapshot of in-flight tasks, awaits via asyncio.wait with float(budget) timeout, and emits per-task abandoned log lines using cached metadata. TestDrain::test_drain_counts_succeeded_and_abandoned schedules 3 fast + 2 hanging tasks with shutdown_grace_sec=1 and asserts (3, 2). TestDrain::test_abandoned_tasks_emit_log_line asserts the log line for the hanging case.

completion_promises.criterion_text: GRAPHITI_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SEC env var overrides the default shutdown_grace_sec
completion_promises.evidence: _resolve_default_grace_sec reads GRAPHITI_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_ENV_VAR and falls back to DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SEC. TestShutdownGraceEnvVar covers (a) default when unset, (b) env var override, (c) explicit arg wins over env, (d) non-int falls back, (e) non-positive falls back.

completion_promises.criterion_text: CC-13 conformance test: AST/grep audit asserts add_episode( appears in exactly one location (this module)
completion_promises.evidence: TestCC13SingleCallSite::test_add_episode_appears_exactly_once_in_src walks src/**/*.py with the regex add_episode\s*\(, asserts exactly one match, and asserts the file path ends with async_write.py. Removed the would-be Protocol type so its method definition does not produce a false-positive match. Test passes on the current src tree.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Handler-budget conformance test: a tutor handler calling schedule_write returns within 2s when the underlying add_episode is mocked to hang for 80s
completion_promises.evidence: TestHandlerBudget::test_synthetic_handler_returns_under_2s_with_hanging_mock wraps schedule_write in a synthetic async handler, runs it inside asyncio.wait_for(timeout=2.0) against a hanging fake client, and asserts the handler returns and elapsed < 2s. Drain is invoked at the end with timeout_sec=0 to keep the event loop tidy.
